title: Backup scope · albums
expect: Native searchable virtualized list contains 500 albums; 3 albums · about 4,210 photos is independent of search.
Mac opens the list in Settings detail, without a sheet or Save.
Album rows lead with 44-point rounded cover thumbnails on iPhone and Mac; a missing cover is a neutral tile.
Scroll the virtualized list and toggle a row: cover identity stays stable, off-screen requests cancel, and search, summary and checkmarks remain.

actions.result: All albums stays off and the summary becomes zero.

actions.action: Turn All albums on, then choose one album.
actions.result: The first explicit choice restricts the scope to that album.
